findings.claim: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new instance via NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver f. Logs written through FromContext(ctx), such as those from LoggerMiddleware, go to a throwaway logger, so tests asserting on the original TestLogger see no calls.

verifier.reason: In pkg/plugins/log/fake.go:46-48, TestLogger.FromContext returns NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver f, so calls like m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...) in pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:58 record logs on a discarded TestLogger instance rather than on the original test logger.

findings.claim: ContextualLoggerMiddleware's QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth and CollectMetrics dereference req.PluginContext with no nil check on req, so a nil request panics. Other middlewares, including LoggerMiddleware, guard against nil requests.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go:39-57, QueryData (line 40), CallResource (line 45), CheckHealth (line 50), and CollectMetrics (line 55) all dereference req.PluginContext without checking if req == nil, whereas sibling middlewares such as LoggerMiddleware (pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:62-104) guard against nil requests. In production client.Decorator rejects nil requests before invoking middlewares (pkg/plugins/manager/client/decorator.go:29-65), limiting the panic to direct/standalone calls.
